headlines.text: On this day in 2023, the AEW World Trios Titles was up for grabs as Acclaimed & B.Gunn vs. Top Flight & Andretti went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 6.15. It was the first title opportunity of Top Flight & Andretti's career. Acclaimed & B.Gunn was chasing gold for the 10th time. The Acclaimed and Billy Gunn fought off a spirited challenge from Top Flight and Action Andretti, closing it out with the Mic Drop/Total Elimination combo to retain the AEW World Trios Championship.

Turning the clock back to 2020: the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as The Young Bucks vs. The Acclaimed went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.71. It was the first title opportunity of The Acclaimed's career. It was the 20th time the AEW World Tag Team Titles had been on the line, a nice marker in that championship's story. An early title opportunity for a very new team, just one week into their AEW Dynamite run ? The Acclaimed pushed the champions to their limit before the Bucks retained with the BTE Trigger, a real signal of the bright future ahead for Bowens and Caster.
Rewind to 2022, when Preston Vance made their AEW debut in a Casino Battle Royale match, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.24.
